name: REISHI
blurb: SLOW. CO2 DECIDES ANTLER OR CAP.

overview.v: Grown for drying, not fresh sale. Antlers and tinctures sell.
Ganoderma lingzhi via John Donahue (European origin).
Medicinal evidence points to immune modulation; many studies are small. Do not repeat claims you cannot source.

cultivation.v: Short logs colonize faster than long ones and give better fruit bodies than bags.
10 lb bags can turn mostly into antlers over a year.

timeline.v: Months to a year in the bag.
3-4 months for antlers to reach the bag top; up to a year.

climate.v: 3,000-5,000 ppm in the bag gives antlers; below 1,000 ppm gives kidney caps.

yield_.v: About 80%, against about 95% for most. Dries easily.

hazards.v: Heavy spore loads; wear a respirator. Can take up heavy metals from its substrate.

notes.v: Fruits for months; year-old bags are mostly antler.
